mechanism: Esomeprazole inhibits CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, reducing primaquine metabolism and potentially increasing primaquine exposure and hemolytic toxicity risk, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia symptoms; consider alternative PPI or H2-receptor antagonist if primaquine use is essential; baseline G6PD screening recommended before primaquine initiation.
